en.title: Create Jupyter notebooks
en.description: Scaffold clean experiment and tutorial notebooks with bundled templates.
tasks: Scaffold clean experiment and tutorial notebooks with bundled templates.
prerequisites: Python; Jupyter to run notebooks. Upstream helpers use $CODEX_HOME/skills/jupyter-notebook/.
en.example: Use jupyter-notebook. Create a notebook that loads this CSV, checks missing values, and plots three useful summaries.
en.expectedResult: An .ipynb with ordered cells, explanations, and explicit data assumptions.
limitations: Scaffolding does not execute or validate every cell; run the notebook in your environment.

zh.title: 创建 Jupyter Notebook
zh.description: 通过包内模板创建结构清晰的实验或教程 Notebook。
tasks: 通过包内模板创建结构清晰的实验或教程 Notebook。
prerequisites: Python；运行 Notebook 需 Jupyter。上游脚本路径使用 $CODEX_HOME/skills/jupyter-notebook/。
zh.example: 请使用 jupyter-notebook：创建 Notebook，读取此 CSV、检查缺失值并绘制三项摘要图。
zh.expectedResult: 单元顺序清晰、含解释与数据假设的 .ipynb 文件。
limitations: 创建骨架不代表所有单元已执行，需在自己的环境运行。
